APC TECHNOLOGY (PVT) LTD — WEBSITE PACKAGE
==========================================

WHAT IS INCLUDED
- 9 standalone HTML pages: index, about, services, CCTV, access control,
  networking, maintenance, solutions and contact.
- Shared responsive navigation, footer and interaction scripts.
- Locally bundled, optimized WebP security imagery generated for the design.
- Original APC Technology logo extracted from the supplied promotional screenshot.
- WhatsApp inquiry form: it prepares a message and opens WhatsApp. It does not
  store messages or submit to a server. There is NO backend or inbox in this ZIP.
- Responsive styling and accessible reduced-motion support.

HOW TO PREVIEW
1. Extract the ZIP.
2. Double-click index.html (all site content works without hosting).
3. For a local server, use e.g. XAMPP htdocs or python -m http.server 8000.
4. Upload every file and folder together into public_html on your web host.

BUSINESS DATA USED

No. 33, Hibutana, Mulleriyawa, Sri Lanka

WhatsApp uses 077 492 5615 by default. Confirm that this line has WhatsApp.

BEFORE GOING LIVE
- Confirm official address spelling, WhatsApp number and both phone numbers.
- Replace assets/images/apc-original-logo.webp with a high-resolution official logo
  when the original artwork is available. Screenshot extraction is not vector quality.
- Photos are AI-generated visual illustrations, NOT evidence of APC's completed jobs.
- Add verified project photos and references only after client approval.
- Add a business domain and domain-based canonical/OG URLs after hosting is decided.
- Confirm service capabilities and any brand authorization before adding claims.
- Test WhatsApp form on both desktop and mobile with real customer device.
- Custom email/inbox submissions require a backend, email API or form service.
- Google Fonts load from Google where network is available; system fonts are fallback.

CODE
assets/css/style.css — global styles and animations
assets/js/main.js — responsive nav, FAQ, reveal, quote/WhatsApp links

DESIGN: Original premium technology UI, not copied from competitors.
